description: A0 image role routing classification dataset manifest
label_notes: A0 is the entry gatekeeper. It classifies image_role, not disease or maturity. Images may come from existing FFB, Ganoderma, UAV datasets re-labeled by role. 'unknown' covers images that don't clearly belong to any production role.

split_strategy.constraint: Images from the same source dataset or session should stay in the same split
split_strategy.notes: A0 data may be bootstrapped from existing task datasets with role re-labeling

notes: A0 model is the routing gatekeeper, not a production predictor
Training data can be bootstrapped from other task datasets by re-labeling image_role
This manifest will evolve as dedicated A0 datasets are collected
